Petitioner has filed the instant petition seeking directions to SRPC to provide necessary information to the Petitioner for the year 2020-21. Petitioner has prayed that SRPC should identify the intra-state lines owned and operated by Petitioner in its capacity as STU (APTRANSCO), which have been used for inter-state power for 2020-2021, to enable Petitioner to seek a tariff from this Commission. 44. Statement of Reasons under the Sharing Regulation, 2020 states the following: view that the lines proposed by the Petitioner cannot be considered as inter-state and its charges cannot be levied on beneficiaries of other States.
title: Petition under Section 79 of the Electricity Act, 2003, read with Regulation 111 and 113 of the CERC (Conduct Of Business) Regulations 1999, seeking directions to the Southern Regional Power Committee to provide necessary information regarding Intra-State transmission lines falling under Regulation 2(1)(ee) CERC (Sharing of Inter-State Transmission Charges And Losses) Regulations, 2020.
